items.claim: Defines the inverse determinant-line holonomy for a smooth Fredholm chiral Dirac family with fixed metric, spin structure, unitary representation, Quillen metric, Bismut–Freed connection, endpoint gauge arrow, and counterterm convention.
items.argument_disposition: Complete local well-definedness argument for unit-modulus, frame-independent holonomy. Its general anomaly interface remains conditional on the absent batch-41 definition carrier.

items.claim: Defines an oriented spin boundary/bulk pair with inverse boundary line, canonical evaluation, and cancellation criterion Hol_boundary·Hol_bulk=1.
items.argument_disposition: Complete conditional line-duality and holonomy argument; explicitly does not construct a bulk.

items.claim: For a nondynamical SU(2) background on S4 and an explicit index-one hypothesis, computes I6=0, the center-loop boundary phase (−1)^N, its mod-two-index bulk phase, cancellation, and the finite BC2 invariant-weight check.
items.argument_disposition: Complete conditional proof from the explicitly stated index input (the source states n_L−n_R=1) and adopted mod-two bulk response. No local Atiyah–Singer proof or continuum QFT construction is claimed. The currently unpinned root cor-spin index formula is context only, not an active dependency.

items.claim: Works the one-copy center character, inverse bulk character, two-copy parity, and single-object BC2 normalized sum.
items.argument_disposition: Complete finite character and automorphism-weight calculation. The continuum index input and scope limits are inherited explicitly from the A theorem.
